data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a significant prior year reserve release of GBP 348.3 million, primarily driven by the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2017 and prior years of account to Riverstone. The 2019 year of account closed with a loss, which was an improvement on its prior forecast, but was materially impacted by COVID-19 related event cancellation losses and natural catastrophe events. The 2020 year of account was also affected by COVID-19 and an active North Atlantic Hurricane season. The 2021 calendar year experienced severe weather losses, including Storm Uri and an active Atlantic storm season, leading to the decision to exit London D&F Property and North American Binder businesses to reduce future volatility.
